doc.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13

title: Harold Christophe, Albert Delone and Sylvester Handy: short biographical interviews
summary: Block 0.3 fuses three short interviews: Christophe on his family, guitar, St. John brass band and Rhythm Makers; Delone on his trumpet-playing father, teacher David Jones and his Five Tones band; Handy on his string-band family, Sam Morgan, Celestin and the La Vida band.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played
